label: Off the Record

floors.notes: MAXED, UNWRITTEN. Andres cleared every recurring floor and the rotation rolled over before it reached the ledger — the game keeps no history of past rotations. Entered 10/17 on his word.

lessons: Log the rotation BEFORE it rolls: ToA has no in-game history view, so an unlogged rotation is gone for good. A cleared floor can be replayed with the same team at zero vigor just to capture the clock.
